premises.text: Cross-platform selling is time- and capital-intensive because listings, orders, and inventory must be replicated across platforms
premises.evidence_span: The lack of efficiency and central management across platforms makes cross-platform selling for online merchants time and capital intensive

premises.text: Syncommerce centralizes selling, tracking, and inventory management across multiple sales channels
premises.evidence_span: centralized dashboard allows online merchants to sell, track, and manage inventory across multiple sales channels simultaneously

premises.text: Bulk product import and publish moves thousands of listings to a new channel in minutes
premises.evidence_span: Nicole publishes all her 5,000 products to her new Etsy store. She can track, manage, and continue to expand through the Synchromesh dashboard in minutes

premises.text: Real-time multi-directional product and inventory sync updates stock across channels when orders arrive
premises.evidence_span: real-time multi-directional syncing of product data

premises.text: Product is optimized and affordable for small businesses versus large-business or async competitors
premises.evidence_span: Syncommerce provides affordable and optimized solutions for small businesses

premises.text: Subscription pricing tiers from $40–$200 depend on listed products and connected channels
premises.evidence_span: monthly subscription ranges from $40 to $200 per month

value.text: Effective efficient multichannel retailing so merchants sell more and work less
value.evidence_span: Syncommerce makes effective and efficient multichannel retailing for online merchants a reality

causal_links.evidence_span: affordable and optimized solutions for small businesses

notes: Independent run: merged 190% lift statistic into framing rather than a separate demand premise; folded competitor contrasts into SMB-fit premise. Traction and Amazon announcement excluded.
